# ESS viewer fixtures

These are unedited `ess generate --kind docs-ir` outputs from ESS 0.77.0, generated from Mandate `systems/mandate` at 99e28552 and Connectors `ess` at 65c928d72. `mandate.json` covers Mandate's foundation specification and is byte-identical to Mandate's committed `generated/docs-ir/document.json`; `connectors.json` covers the Connectors model. Per-page provenance records preserve exact source and contract digests. The tests consume both complete documents to prevent project-specific assumptions from entering the shared viewer. Regenerate fixtures through ESS, never edit generated bytes to make a test pass.

The fixtures demonstrate presentation compatibility. Their inclusion makes no assertion of runtime enforcement or service availability.
